title: LOST MAN
titleRomaji: LOST MAN
titleNative: LOST MAN
synopsis: There lives a man who has lost his memory and can’t remember where he’s from, and who he is, including his name. He just goes by the name Matsumoto and the one and only thing he remembers is how to play soccer. However, the one thing he does remember, he does exceptionally well, even better than the professionals. He sells his ridiculous soccer skills to teams and guarantees them goals and, even more important, wins. As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.

titleRomaji: Kanojo wo Dere Saseru Houhou wo, Shourai Kekkon Suru Ore dake ga Shitteiru
titleNative: 彼女をデレさせる方法を、将来結婚する俺だけが知っている
synonyms: The Only One Who Knows How to Make Her Fall for Me Is the Future Me Who Marries Her
synopsis: Q: Why did you choose this high school? A: Because my future wife is enrolling here. When I woke up, I had time-leaped 15 years into the past. Standing before me was Arisugawa Yuki, my future wife, wearing a school uniform I don't recognize. In the original timeline, we wouldn't meet until we became adults and eventually got married, so we're still strangers for now. But I know that she distrusts people, has no friends, and spends her school days alone. I also know she'll deeply regret that time in the future. So this time, I'm going to rewrite her youth. "How do you know my secret!?" "Because we're husband and wife... in the future." (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

titleRomaji: Anemone no Shishuu
titleNative: アネモネの刺繍
synonyms: I Remember the Love for My Angel
synopsis: Meet Julio, a gay thirty-year-old man and best-selling author. Despite his success in publishing, however, Julio lives a life of solitude, keeping his true identity a secret while harboring feelings of inferiority regarding his sexuality and bland appearance. His world is soon turned upside-down, though, when he encounters a beautiful young man by the name of Angel. Standing up against the world's discriminations and prejudices, the two are soon captivated by each other... Dedicated to all who are seeking romance, this is a story of cinematic human love!! (Source: Renta!)

synopsis: Kazuki Ishii has his life turned upside down — and is driven to suicide — after getting caught up in the romantic entanglements of his friend Teruhito Amada, who is wildly popular with the opposite sex, like the hero of a romantic comedy. However, a miracle occurs, and time is rewound back to the morning of his high school entrance ceremony. In his second chance at life, Kazuki tries to keep a low profile, avoid making friends, and live a peaceful life. But for some reason, Meiko Hikata — Amada’s childhood friend and a cool beauty known as the “Ice Empress”—begins to take an interest in him. (Source: Natalie, translated)
